Which idea from earlier lessons do you expect to need most here, and why?
batna i guess
Hi, I'm Dana Okafor. Thanks for making time. I really need your help with this.
Where would you start with my situation?
can you just tell me what to say? whats the right answer here
I can't answer that for you. Your judgement is exactly what I came for. Start with what you're surest of. Where would you start with my situation?
ok what is your situation
Can you say a bit more about what you're basing that on?
im not basing it on anything, you didnt tell me anything about the offer. like how much did they offer you
Maybe look back at the course material from before we started. Is there a part of it that helps here?
ok fine. first thing id figure out is your batna, like what do you do if this offer falls through. do you have another offer or are you staying at your current job?
I've always heard that the best opening move is to state your bottom line so nobody wastes time. Any reason I shouldn't go with that?
probably dont do that, if you say your bottom line thats all theyll give you. you didnt answer about the other offer tho
What else should I be thinking about before I decide?
the other stuff besides salary i guess. like signing bonus or start date or remote days, stuff thats cheap for them but matters to you
Can you say a bit more about what you're basing that on?

the course stuff said if you only fight about salary you just split it, but if you add other things you can both get more. so like if you want to start later and they dont care that much thats a free win
Maybe look back at the course material from before we started. Is there a part of it that helps here?
i literally just used the course material. what do you actually want from this job, like why do you want more money
What would you do differently from what I had planned?
you never told me what you planned. whatever. dont lead with your bottom line, know your batna, and ask for more than just salary
Can you say a bit more about what you're basing that on?
Thanks for your time. I'm still not sure what to do, so I'll think about it some more.

meh. it kept asking the same stuff. i guess the part where i said ask for start date and bonus not just salary
What would you do differently if you did it again?
ask about her interests earlier i guess

probably the same idea of adding more stuff to trade instead of just fighting over the deadline, like we give them more time if they give us a person. and figure out what happens if we dont agree. difference is its the same company so you cant really walk away
